decisions.reason: The kitchen configuration and cabinet dimensions do not change Unit 2's bathroom-placement requirement.

The drawing must still show the placement of three kitchen cabinet sets; the source adds design details owned by the kitchen requirement without changing the drawing deliverable or its required-content categories.
The open-plan kitchen configuration applies within each dwelling but does not change the required dwelling count of three.
The same message independently establishes the existing-wall preservation policy, which is already represented by its own Event; the kitchen-specific modification does not further change that policy.
The kitchen configuration and cabinet dimensions do not change Unit 3's bathroom requirement.
